summary: For one fixed exact-rank-three target with spectrum {1,-1,1} and a physical leverage-1/2 zero pivot, cap-one fragmented iid inputs yield a scalar leakage T for which the conditional pair-height moment E||p_(Y,Z|T)||_infinity^(2/3)=3[N-1+2^(2/3)]/(4N^(1/3)) grows like (3/4)N^(2/3). Thus conditioning on that scalar leakage and paying the positive conditional 2/3-height moment cannot give a universal density bound. The actual quadratic form remains uniformly controlled: applying account02/B10 QFORM-HYPERBOLIC-SQUARE-v1 in an original-coordinate chart gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=4sqrt(2). This refutes only the proof interface, not QFORM.
